turns.speaker: spk_1
turns.text: Haan beta, aao. Kya hua?

turns.speaker: spk_0
turns.text: Sir do teen din se gala bahut kharab hai aur naak beh rahi hai.

turns.speaker: spk_1
turns.text: Fever?

turns.speaker: spk_0
turns.text: Halka sa tha kal raat, abhi nahi hai.

turns.speaker: spk_1
turns.text: Saans mein koi problem?

turns.speaker: spk_0
turns.text: No sir, breathing is fine.

turns.speaker: spk_1
turns.text: Any allergy to medicines?

turns.speaker: spk_0
turns.text: No sir.

turns.speaker: spk_1
turns.text: Throat thoda red hai. Ye viral URTI hai, antibiotic ki zarurat nahi. Cetirizine 10 mg raat ko, paanch din. Garam paani se gargle kariye. Teen din mein theek nahi hua toh wapas aana.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Bataiye, kya pareshani hai?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: मुझे कल से दस्त हो रहे हैं, पांच छह बार.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Ulti?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Haan do baar ulti bhi hui.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Pet mein dard hai?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Thoda thoda marod hai.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Potty mein khoon aaya?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Nahi.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Pulse 102 hai. Halka dehydration hai. Gastroenteritis lag raha hai. Electral har dast ke baad. Ondem 4 mg din mein do baar, do din ke liye. Do din baad dikhaiye agar theek na ho.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Reports laaye? Fasting sugar 192 hai, kaafi zyada.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Ji, aajkal pyaas bhi bahut lagti hai aur thakan rehti hai.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Dawai regular le rahe ho? Glycomet?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Kabhi kabhi bhool jaata hoon.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: BP bhi check kiya, 138 by 86. Sugar uncontrolled hai. Glycomet 500 mg subah shaam khane ke baad, aur Glimepiride 1 mg subah naashte se pehle, ek mahine ke liye. Ek mahine baad HbA1c karwa ke dikhaiye.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Haan ji aunty, boliye.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Doctor saab, peshab mein jalan ho rahi hai teen din se, aur baar baar jaana padta hai.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Bukhar?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Haan, kal thoda bukhar tha.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Koi dawai se reaction hua hai pehle kabhi?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Haan, Septran se poore badan pe daane ho gaye the.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Theek hai, Septran nahi denge. Urine infection lag raha hai. Niftran 100 mg din mein do baar, paanch din ke liye. Crocin 650 zarurat pade toh. Urine culture bhejiye.

turns.speaker: spk_0
turns.text: Isko teen din se tez bukhar hai doctor sahab, aur badan dard bhi.

turns.speaker: spk_1
turns.text: Khansi zukaam?

turns.speaker: spk_0
turns.text: Nahi, woh nahi hai.

turns.speaker: spk_1
turns.text: Temperature 102 hai. Viral fever hai. Main Azithral 500 de deta hoon din mein ek baar teen din, aur Dolo 650 din mein teen baar teen din ke liye. Paani khoob pilaiye.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: BP 158 by 98 aa raha hai. Sar dard rehta hai?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Haan subah subah sir bhaari rehta hai, aur kabhi kabhi chakkar.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Seene mein dard ya ghabrahat?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Nahi, aisa kuch nahi.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Pehle se BP ki dawai lete ho?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Nahi, pehli baar dikha raha hoon.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Ye hypertension hai. Amlodipine 5 mg roz ek baar, ek mahine. Namak kam kariye, roz walk kariye. Do hafte baad BP check karwa ke aaiye.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Kya hua? Saans phool rahi hai?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Haan doctor, raat ko zyada. Do hafte se. Mujhe bachpan se dama hai.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Khansi?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Sookhi khansi hai, raat mein.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Oxygen 95 hai. Asthma flare hai. Asthalin inhaler 2 puff zarurat pade toh, aur Montair 10 mg raat ko do hafte ke liye. Inhaler lene ka tarika sikha deta hoon.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Kitne din se bukhar hai?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Chaar din se. Aankhon ke peeche dard aur poora badan toot raha hai.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Koi rash ya daane?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Haan, haath pe kuch laal daane aaye hain.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Platelets check karwane padenge, dengue ho sakta hai. Sirf paracetamol 650 din mein teen baar lijiye. Brufen ya Combiflam bilkul mat lena. Kal report leke aaiye.
